parsed.name: 派能储能电池模组
parsed.description: 用于与派能储能锂电池模组或其电池管理系统通信，扫描总线上的电池模块，并读取协议版本、厂商信息、系统参数、管理信息、序列号及运行数值，适合实验室储能系统监测与集成。
parsed.description_en: Used to communicate with Pylontech energy storage battery modules or their battery management interface, scan battery modules on the bus, and read protocol version, manufacturer information, system parameters, management information, serial numbers, and operating values for laboratory energy storage monitoring and integration.
